product.title: Aspen's Past to Present Historic Tour

description.text: Aspen may known for glitz and glamour today, but like many Colorado mountain towns, it started as a humble mining town. Follow your guide as he shares history, local folklore, and insider knowledge of downtown Aspen. Stops include Wheeler Opera House, Wagner Park, Pitkin County Library, Aspen Mountain / Ajax, Smuggler Mountain, Mill Street Fountain. The tour happens rain or shine, so dress appropriately for mountain weather changes and come prepared to immerse yourself in local legends. Ideal for visitors basing in Aspen who want a guided mountain-town experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
